description:
Twin Falls properties (twelve): what a room costs, by the night and by the week, and the rules that govern a stay: the minimum stay, how a stay under a week is priced, the 30-day cap, the weekly-only studio rule, the 8% Idaho lodging tax, and why $1,000 is never a monthly rate.
High Country Motel, Bellevue (separate; Twin Falls rates and tax do not apply): 766 S Main St, Bellevue, Idaho, about 64 road miles north of Twin Falls; also run by New Leaf Properties. Rates from $115 a night, $600 a week, $1,490 a month, plus applicable taxes. Subject to availability. Single accommodates 1 to 2 guests; Double accommodates 1 to 4 guests. Half-kitchenette mini suites are Doubles. High Country taxes total 11% for stays of 30 days or less: Idaho sales 6%, Idaho travel and convention 2%, and Bellevue local option 3%. Longer continuous stays may be exempt; ask the front desk. Estimated price, based on our starting rates. The front desk will confirm your exact rate and total, including all applicable taxes, before your stay. No payment is taken online. New Leaf office: (208) 733-2010. Book online, by phone at (208) 721-0067 (front desk), or through booking-enabled chat. Your request requires staff confirmation. Chat stays are capped at 30 nights; longer stays through the front desk. Book a room: https://highcountrymotelid.com/reserve.html
